name: mssql-readonly-mcp
description: An MCP server that lets an AI assistant read one on-premises SQL Server database.

connection_string.title: SQL Server connection string
connection_string.description: Paste only this text, with your values: Server=<host>;Database=<database>;User ID=<login>;Password=<password>. Port, certificate and which login: docs/install.md on the project's GitHub page.

audit_log.title: Audit file path
audit_log.description: Type a full path in your home folder, for example C:\Users\<you>\mcp-audit\claude-desktop.jsonl or /Users/<you>/mcp-audit/claude-desktop.jsonl. Folder rights and details: docs/install.md on the project's GitHub page.
